title: Source Code: Remove Duplicates From a Sorted Linked List

blocks.content: Source Code: Remove Duplicates From a Sorted Linked List
To remove duplicates from a sorted linked list, we need to traverse the linked list and compare subsequent nodes.
If the current node and the next node have equal values, we will delete the next node.

1# delete duplicate nodes from sorted list
2def remove_duplicates(self):
3    # condition to handle empty linked list
4    if not self.head:
5        return
6    current = self.head 
7    # traverse the linked list
8    while current.next:
9        # if current and next nodes are equal
10        # delete the next node
11        if current.data == current.next.data:
12            current.next = current.next.next
13        else:
14            current = current.next

Original Linked List:
30->55->55->80->80->80->None

After removing duplicates:
30->55->80->None
